messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: ctmm spring webinar
parts:
There will be a 1-hour webinar on both basic features (variograms & AKDE) and newer features in ctmm (meta-analyses, RSFs, and RSF-kernel AKDEs) at the end of this month, followed by a question-and-answer session. You can vote on the schedule here:

https://doodle.com/meeting/participate/id/dNkrLL6e

As we have exceeded the capacity of Skype groups, the webinar will take place on Zoom. A registration link will be provided when the date is set.

Attached is the RSF-AKDE home-range estimate of a tapir, where the 50% core area is delineated by the highest density region (left) and by a convex region (right).
